_about: The 10 pilot events (ANALYSIS_PLAN.md section 13). Excluded from every main result, together with any main event within 50 km and 7 days. Seeds are approximate river locations; the pilot snaps each to the GloFAS cell, finds the peak inside `search_window` from the reanalysis, and records both in pilot/out/. Chosen by hand to cover both regions, all years, both S1B eras, an S1B plan gap and the three 2024 replay events.

events.why: Replay event, hand-checked; regression case (227.9 h)
